snippet.title: The Truth You Know Isn’t the Truth | Fire and Ashes — Official Story Trailer 2026
snippet.description:
"Watch the official announcement trailer for Fire and Ashes, an upcoming survival horror game coming to Steam, Epic Games Store, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5, and Nintendo Switch."

Can you survive when your own voice can betray you? Welcome to my gameplay of Fire and Ashes, the terrifying new psychological survival horror game developed by ASDstudio and published by Antelus Games!

In this video, we step into the shoes of Henry Gray in 1977, awakening inside a blood-soaked bathtub of a nightmare psychiatric hospital. But here is the catch: Fire and Ashes features advanced voice recognition mechanics. The monsters, crazed patients, and otherworldly entities hunting us down can actually hear your real-world breathing, whispers, and panic through the microphone! Every scream could be your last.

Watch as we try to solve eerie puzzles, maintain sanity, manage the Electric Voice pacification tool, and escape the deep secrets of Henry's dark past. Will we find the truth, or succumb to the madness?

If you enjoy pure psychological horror and intense stealth mechanics like Amnesia or Alien Isolation, make sure to try.

📌 Wishlist Fire and Ashes on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1751730/FIRE_AND_ASHES/

📌 Support the developers: Follow ASDstudio and Antelus Games!
